item.title: U.S. ambassador to Israel says Israel sent Iron Dome batteries, personnel to UAE
item.description: Israel sent Iron Dome anti-missile batteries and personnel to operate them to the United Arab Emirates to defend the country during the Iran war, the U.S. ambassador to the country said Tuesday.

item.title: EU diplomats agree to sanction Hamas leaders and Israeli settlers
item.description: The unanimous decision by the European Union, agreed to on Monday, was sparked by growing outrage over the devastation in Gaza during the Israel-Hamas war.

item.title: April inflation rate surges to 3.8% amid uncertainty in the Middle East
item.description: Inflation rose to 3.8% year over year in April and 0.6% month over month as the war in Iran continues to affect the economy. NBC News' Christine Romans and editor-in-chief at Investopedia Caleb Silver report on the economic situation amid uncertainty in the Middle East.

item.title: Trump Set to Meet With China's Xi Jinping: Here's What is at Stake
item.description: President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping are expected to publicly emphasize stability during Thursday’s high-stakes summit after the two superpowers have been locked in an escalating economic struggle over trade, access to China’s rare earth minerals and AI. Trump is also suggesting he’ll lean on Xi to force Tehran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the war. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

item.title: Trump says ceasefire is ‘on life support’ after rejecting ‘unacceptable’ proposal from Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump said the ceasefire with Iran is “on life support” and “unbelievably weak” after the two sides exchanged fire this weekend, with Trump labeling Iran’s peace proposal as “garbage.”

item.title: Israel to hold military tribunal for Palestinians accused in 2023 Hamas-led attacks
item.description: Israel is planning a military tribunal to prosecute several hundred Palestinians accused of perpetrating the Hamas-led attacks of Oct. 7, 2023.

item.title: Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire proposal response. And, Congress to tackle ICE funding
item.description: Trump rejected Iran's response to a U.S. peace proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable." And, Congressional Republicans are trying to push for three years of funding for immigration enforcement.

item.title: Military drills in the Philippines affect the country's most vulnerable communities
item.description: Military drills disrupted fishing livelihoods in the Philippines, sparking protests as locals are caught between a great power rivalry and rising economic pressures linked to the Iran war.

item.title: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi transferred to a Tehran hospital, her foundation says
item.description: Nobel Peace laureate and activist Narges Mohammadi has been transferred to a Tehran hospital more than a week after collapsing in prison, her foundation said Sunday.
